notes: Cover-only research pass, 2026-09-16, for 31 published universities across Albania, Australia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, British Virgin Islands, Canada, Czechia, Fiji, France, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Kazakhstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Macau, Malta and the Netherlands whose cover_image_url is empty. Method: (1) Wikimedia Commons via the MediaWiki API (category enumeration with imageinfo/extmetadata, plus full-text file search in English and in the local language - Universiteit Utrecht, Ostravska univerzita, Latvijas Universitate, Utenos kolegija, Sveuciliste u Mostaru, Univerzitet u Sarajevu, Universiteti Epoka etc.) and en/sq.wikipedia pageimages for lead-image identification; (2) where Commons had nothing, the institution's own domain (og:image, hero and campus-page imagery fetched with curl). Every nominated URL was checked with curl -sIL and returned HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type, and every nominated image was additionally opened and inspected visually before acceptance, which is how several plausible-looking candidates (SMK's branded social card, Mediterranean University of Albania's graduation and inauguration photos, UET's ceremony photo, the Rome Business School Commons file that is actually a logo, Ponce/PHSU's 325px BVI thumbnail, University of Fiji's blank texture image) were rejected. SYSTEMIC FINDING: the July 2026 alphabetical pass appears to have researched almost exclusively on institutional websites and barely used Wikimedia Commons; as a result it held large, extremely well-covered public universities (ANU, UNSW, Utrecht, Galway, Debrecen, Latvia, Ostrava, EDHEC, Al-Farabi, MacEwan, Mount Royal, Douglas, Utena) that each have dedicated, richly populated Commons categories. Those are the bulk of this batch's wins. Caveats flagged per entry: two ready entries (Epoka 832px, University of Mostar Faculty of Medicine 800px) fall below the 1000px-wide preference; one (St. Lawrence College) is portrait rather than landscape; one (Georgian College) depicts the Owen Sound campus rather than the Barrie main campus; two (Macau UST, and by extension its Faculty of Medicine record) use parent-university campus imagery, stated explicitly. Commons entries are freely licensed but nearly all require attribution and share-alike - the author and licence string in each rightsBasis must be carried through to the public credit line.

entries.reason: No image that identifies either the Faculty of Medicine or the parent university's own building could be verified. entries.universityName: EDU - Digital Education Holdings (EDU Medical, Faculty of Medicine)
entries.reason: No verifiable image, and a structural reason to expect none. Identity was resolved this pass (the first pass had treated the name as garbled): EDU is a European institution of higher education operated by Digital Education Holdings Ltd, registered at Chaplain's House, Villa Bighi, Marina Street, Kalkara, Malta, and EDU Medical is its online/digital medical degree provider - it is described as Europe's first digital medical school, so it has no teaching campus of its own to photograph. Wikimedia Commons: no category or file for 'EDU Malta', 'Digital Education Holdings' or 'EDU Medical'. Official domains: https://medical.edu.mt/ and https://edu.edu.mt failed to connect over curl (connection error, HTTP 000) on repeated attempts, so no og:image or hero could be read. Nothing was nominated; a photograph of Villa Bighi as a building would identify a historic Kalkara site rather than the institution, and the brief requires strictness for small private providers.
